summary: A switch for an on/off setting, with its label, description and error beside it, taking part in forms.

label.note: Visible label next to the track and accessible name. Required: shadow DOM keeps an external <label for> from reaching the inner input.

hideLabel.note: Visually hides the label; it stays the accessible name. Use only when the row has other visible text naming the switch.

error.note: Error message. Setting it marks the field invalid and blocks form submission.

value.note: Submitted with the form while on.

checked.note: Current state (on). Not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset.

required.note: Native required: the switch must be on to submit. Adds an aria-hidden asterisk after the label.

disabled.note: Cannot be focused or toggled; dimmed; not submitted. Also set by an ancestor disabled fieldset.

anatomy.name: field
anatomy.notes: Grid: track in the first column; label, description and error in the second.

anatomy.name: control
anatomy.notes: Track wrapper; positions the thumb over the native input.

anatomy.name: input
anatomy.notes: Native <input type="checkbox" role="switch">; receives focus, Space and validation. Paints the track.

anatomy.name: thumb
anatomy.notes: Decorative knob, aria-hidden; slides to the end side when on (mirrors in RTL).

anatomy.name: label
anatomy.notes: Native <label for> in the same shadow root.

anatomy.name: error
anatomy.notes: Persistent polite live region; text appears when invalid.

input.note: Each toggle. Native and composed, so it crosses the shadow boundary.

change.note: Toggle committed. Re-dispatched from the host because native change is not composed (NativeControl).

focus-visible.note: 3px solid ring and border in ring color (a translucent ring would fall under 3:1).

checked.note: Track fills with primary and the thumb moves to the end; position, not color alone, shows the state.

invalid.trigger: error set, or required and off after blur or a submit attempt

disabled.trigger: disabled attribute or disabled ancestor fieldset

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: The label prop, through a native <label for> in the same shadow root.

formAssociation.note: ElementInternals: setFormValue(value) only while on, validity mirrored from the inner input (required -> valueMissing), formResetCallback restores the default checked state from the attribute, a disabled fieldset disables it without overwriting the disabled prop, disabled is not submitted. Built with FormAssociated + NativeControl.

accessibility.targetSize: Default track 32x20px, sm 24x16px; the label is part of the clickable row. The sm track relies on the label row and the gap for the WCAG 2.5.8 spacing exception.
accessibility.focusRingVisible: On keyboard focus of the input; 3px ring in switch.focus-ring.color.
accessibility.missingNameWarning: Dev-only console warning, once, when label is empty.

keyboard.Tab: move focus to and from the switch
keyboard.Enter: submits the form (implicit submission; the control has no form owner in its shadow root, SB-0009); it does not toggle

aria: role="switch" with the native checked state exposed as aria-checked
aria-describedby -> description and error ids (same root)
required: native required; the asterisk is aria-hidden
error: sets a customError validity, so the form blocks submission
announcements: error text is announced once when it appears (persistent aria-live=polite region)
state change is announced by the switch role as on or off

useCases.when: A setting that is on or off, such as a notification or feature preference
useCases.use: sb-switch with a label that names the setting

useCases.when: The setting must be on before the form can be sent
useCases.use: required with a label that states it

antiPatterns.pattern: One of several options, or a yes/no that is only a choice recorded on submit
antiPatterns.why: A switch reads as an immediate on/off setting

antiPatterns.pattern: Choosing exactly one option from several
antiPatterns.why: A switch is one independent on/off value

antiPatterns.pattern: A button that stays pressed to change a view
antiPatterns.why: Toggle is a pressed button, not a form setting

antiPatterns.pattern: A label that flips with the state (Enable / Disable)
antiPatterns.why: The name must stay the same; the switch role announces on or off
antiPatterns.alternative: A label that names the setting

coverage: label is the name; role is switch; label click toggles
Space toggles; Enter does not toggle; keyboard focus ring
size default and sm render the declared track dimensions
checked moves the thumb and paints differently; thumb mirrors in RTL
description and error in the accessible description; aria-invalid
required: native required, aria-hidden asterisk, invalid after blur
input and change composed, once per toggle
form value only while on, custom value, reset to attribute default, validity, disabled fieldset and re-enable, error customError, label for

drift.contract: label, description and error are props of Switch
drift.realization: shadcn composes Field parts around Switch; shadow DOM requires them inside
shadcn default is bg-input, a lighter neutral; changed for WCAG 1.4.11

drift.contract: 32x20px default, 24x16px sm, from semantic size tokens

drift.realization: not reflected: the attribute is the default restored by form reset

openQuestions.question: Contract content drafted with the contract-author skill (visual reference, WAI-ARIA APG)?
openQuestions.answer: Yes: APG switch pattern, label row beside the track; shadcn Switch for look and sizes.

openQuestions.question: Custom ARIA or a native control?
openQuestions.recommendation: Native input type=checkbox with role=switch (SB-0007 prefers native elements).
openQuestions.answer: Native checkbox input with role=switch: native Space, validity and required.

openQuestions.question: Is checked reflected to an attribute?
openQuestions.answer: No. The attribute is the default that form reset restores; checked is a property.

openQuestions.question: Is label required?
openQuestions.recommendation: Yes, like Checkbox and Input; hide-label keeps it as the name.

openQuestions.question: What does required mean for a switch?
openQuestions.recommendation: It must be on to submit, as a native required checkbox.
openQuestions.answer: Must be on (valueMissing while off); the label should state the agreement.

openQuestions.question: Which sizes?
openQuestions.answer: default (32x20px) and sm (24x16px); the API vocabulary maps them to medium and small.

openQuestions.question: Does Enter toggle the switch?
openQuestions.recommendation: No: Space toggles (APG); Enter submits the form (SB-0009).
openQuestions.answer: No. Enter submits the form via requestSubmit().

openQuestions.question: Are on/off texts drawn in the track?
openQuestions.recommendation: No: position and fill show the state; the role announces it.

openQuestions.question: What is submitted while off?
openQuestions.answer: Nothing while off; value (default on) while on.
